extracted.name: Milk cake (tres leches)😊#cookpad
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp vanilla essence, 1 cup all purpose flour,1tsp baking soda
1 cup milk,1 pack cream,3 tbsn sugar(milk syrup to soak cake)
Caramel sauce(1/2cup sugar when caramelized add 2tbsn
instruction_lines: First take egg,oil,vanilla and sugar.whisk it then add flour n baking soda.whisk well.
Now bake cake at 150°c for 20 mins or acc to ur oven.
Now prepare whipped cream,milk mixture n even caramel
Now poke the cake all over then add the milk mixture then caramel then cream or u can decorate as u like.
